input.answer: Canada's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate fell 0.6 percentage points between September 2025 and September 2026, from 7.1% to 6.5%. The arithmetic is 6.5 − 7.1 = −0.6. I used the total population, both genders, ages 15 and over.

answer_values.label: change_abs
answer_values.description: Change in seasonally adjusted unemployment rate, Sept 2025 to Sept 2026 (6.5 − 7.1)
